core_meaning.primary_meaning: Nazira corresponds to the Arabic form نَذِيرَة and is glossed in this record as “Warner.” The record associates the form with root ن ذ ر (n-dh-r). The lexical gloss describes the word-form; Qur’anic occurrence, religious recommendation, popularity, and a name-bearer’s character are separate claims and are not established by this gloss alone.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Nazira corresponds to the Arabic form نَذِيرَة (Arabic root ن ذ ر (n-dh-r); نَذِيرَة (Nadhīra)). Its core sense is nazira; warner (feminine). Nazira is Arabic نَذِيرَة (Nadhīra) 'warner' (feminine), from the root ن ذ ر (n-dh-r). CRITICAL SOURCE ERROR: the source gave نازرة (a different form); the correct form is نَذِيرَة. The source gloss 'Bright, Radiant, One Who Sees Clearly' is unsupported and has been replaced with the lexical sense. Same name as nazeera.

persian.name: نذیره
persian.long_meaning: Nazira (نذیره) نامی برگرفته از زبان عربی است و معنای اصلی آن نذیره، هشداردهنده است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.
